notes: Question words and function phrases of two or more characters (how, why, what, can, should, a bit, if, please); none can sit inside 练习, 和弦, 音阶, 节奏, 拍, 琶音, 指法 or similar. Doubtful: 需要 and 一些 (function-like, but never inside a music term); 还是 (could occur in a rare phrase but not a guitar word). Single characters such as 的, 吗, 我 are deliberately not listed.
